prompts: Use case: ui-mockup. Create a polished landscape design comparison board for Phonics Hero, an installed iPad phonics game for Korean five-year-olds. Three equal portrait gameplay panels labeled A B C, same content to compare TYPOGRAPHY and COLOR only. Small friendly dinosaur companion at bottom left, primary focus a huge lowercase "a", instruction exact Korean "같은 소리를 찾아요", three answer cards "a" "s" "t", large "Listen" button and "Next" button. Header "Phonics Hero". A: chunky rounded playful display heading and clean readable rounded Korean body, ivory background, cobalt blue primary, sunny yellow selected card, turquoise accents. B: friendly storybook slab heading paired with plain highly readable sans body, light mint background, vivid teal primary, tangerine action, yellow accents. C: bold clean geometric heading paired with open humanist sans body, pale sky background, strong royal blue and coral with lemon accents. All dark navy text, strong contrast, spacious large touch targets, no clutter, no rainbow text, no gradients behind learning letters. Clear typographic hierarchy. Below each panel a small five-color swatch strip and a type specimen "a g I l b d". Render as high-fidelity graphic design mockup, not a photographed tablet. Accurate text; concept study not a claim of real font file or functional game.

Use case: stylized-concept. Landscape professional character concept sheet for a five-year-old child's phonics adventure game. Title "DINOSAUR GUARDIANS". Two visually distinct rows: top labeled HEROES has three brave friendly powerful herbivore dinosaurs: turquoise triceratops shield guardian with wide horns and warm eyes; golden ankylosaurus with massive rounded armored back and club tail; sky-blue long-neck brachiosaurus tall wise protector. Bottom labeled VILLAINS has rust-red lean raptor with sly slanted brows and hooked claws; dark petrol-blue spinosaurus with brilliant orange sail and toothy scheming grin; large FINAL BOSS tyrannosaurus on bottom right, charcoal and lava-orange with pale bone jaw armor and heavy jagged brow, especially impressive unique silhouette. Clearly animal dinosaur bodies not humanoid robots. Premium sculpted clay-animation collectible aesthetic, tactile matte material, strong readable forms, slightly dynamic grounded poses, all full body tails visible and separate. Heroes upright open protective postures; villains forward stalking crouches sharp silhouettes and mischievous menace. Distinct palettes, avoid purple villain stereotype. Clean warm off-white backdrop, subtle ground shadows, no scenery, no letters on characters, no gore wounds or realistic horror. Equal art quality for both sides, boss largest but no overlap.

Use case: stylized-concept. Landscape polished character concept sheet titled "ANIMAL KNIGHTS", a fresh theme for five-year-old phonics game replacing repetitive block toys. High-end 3D animated fairy-tale film look, soft sculpted fur, expressive faces, vivid enamel armor and cloth, beautifully controlled lighting. Six separated full-body characters: top HEROES row lion shield knight broad golden mane cobalt cape; tiny white rabbit wizard tall teal hat expressive long ears and amber star staff; slim russet fox archer green cape curved wooden bow; huge friendly brown bear hammer warrior burnt-orange armor and oversized wooden hammer. Bottom row VILLAINS: sneaky grey weasel thief red mask and hooked walking stick; BOSS: majestic black ram sorcerer with enormous ivory spiral horns, emerald mantle, golden geometric staff, powerful silhouette. Not purple. Each distinct species size body shape equipment posture. Moderate adventurous poses, charming fearless heroes, sly villain, imposing boss without horror. No blood realistic weapons injuries, no franchise logos, no alphabet badges. Clean ivory background, breathing room, no cropping, no overlaps. Small labels HEROES VILLAINS BOSS only. Make genuinely appealing collectible character designs, not generic identical chibi reskins.

Use case: stylized-concept. Landscape character design sheet titled "OCEAN EXPLORERS" for preschool phonics adventure. A visually different style: crisp hand-drawn 2D cel animation, confident dark navy contours, graphic color blocks, small sharp shadow shapes, lively curved gestures; no 3D fur or clay. Four HEROES: coral octopus captain in navy officer jacket with multiple expressive arms and tiny compass; warm brown sea otter explorer in yellow diving vest carrying pearl lantern; turquoise manta ray aviator with goggles and flowing wing silhouette; sturdy orange hermit crab engineer with turquoise shell toolbox. Two VILLAINS: sneaky lime moray eel pirate with crooked grin and patched scarf; FINAL BOSS huge deep navy anglerfish admiral, glowing gold lure and crimson naval cape, crooked crown-shaped fin, angular commanding silhouette. Charming for age5, no horror, gore or human harm. Heroes varied silhouettes, equipment and colors. All full-body separated on pale aqua/offwhite background, generous negative space. Hero row above and villain/boss row below. Limited clean labels HEROES VILLAINS BOSS. No alphabet on characters, no realistic gun, no purple boss. Premium animated series concept art, cheerful yet bold.

Use case: stylized-concept. Landscape character concept sheet titled "SPIRIT GUARDIANS" for a five-year-old phonics game. Distinct style from 3D and cel animation: modern East Asian picture-book gouache with visible dry-brush edges, textured handmade paper, bold ink silhouette accents, vivid selective pigments. Four original kind HEROES: small round cloud goblin with sky-blue swirling eyebrows and tiny drum; elegant vermilion flame fox with three broad paintbrush tails; stocky moss-green stone giant with rounded granite shoulders and tiny yellow flowers; long turquoise river dragon with ribbon-like whiskers and playful face. Two VILLAINS: scruffy soot imp with spiky ink hair, crooked grin and red scarf; BOSS large storm tiger spirit with white-gold fur, indigo thunder stripes and sweeping dark cloud mane, dramatic proud stance, memorable silhouette and amber eyes. No imitation of existing franchise characters. No horror or gore; villain mischievous boss impressive and formidable. Moderately dynamic full body poses, very different proportions, clear silhouettes readable as tiny sprites. Offwhite paper backdrop no scenery, generously spaced top heroes row bottom villains row; labels HEROES VILLAINS BOSS only, no letter emblems. Professional art direction board, beautiful painterly texture not muddy or pastel washed out.
